author: Insta360
description:
Framing can completely change how a shot feels — even if nothing in the scene changes. Key composition techniques like depth, foreground layering, tunnel framing, frame-within-a-frame, triangles, center composition, diagonal lines, and negative space show how framing shapes storytelling and visual impact.

Captured with the Insta360 Ace Pro 2, every angle shows how thoughtful framing can turn everyday scenes into cinematic visuals straight out of camera.
